_comment: Copy this to config/api_keys.json and fill in your values.
_comment_llm_provider: Set llm_provider to 'ollama', 'openai' (local OpenAI-compatible server), 'openai_api' (OpenAI API; billed separately from ChatGPT), or 'gemini' (Google AI)
_comment_llm_url: For OpenAI-compatible: set llm_url to e.g. 'http://localhost:1234'
_comment_llm_remote: ── Optional: prefer a remote PC (e.g. your gaming rig's GPU) for inference, falling back to CPU on this machine if it's off/unreachable. Only takes effect if llm_remote_url is set -- leave unset for single-host behavior (the default, unchanged).
_comment_llm_remote_url: Ollama on your other PC, reachable over LAN or Tailscale, e.g. 'http://192.168.1.50:11434'
_comment_llm_local: Fallback used when llm_remote_url doesn't answer -- CPU inference on this machine.
_comment_llm_health_check: How the remote host's reachability is checked -- interval is how long a verdict is cached (avoids probing on every message), timeout is how long a single probe waits before giving up.
_comment_gemini_escalation: Used by core/tier_router.py's HARD tier -- when the primary llm_provider above is 'ollama'/'openai' and a gemini_api_key is set, complex-reasoning turns are escalated to this Gemini model for just that turn. Falls back to 'gemini-3.8-flash' if unset. Has no effect if llm_provider is already 'gemini'.
_comment_gemini_retry: Seconds to wait before ONE retry of a transient Gemini 429/500/502/503/504 before falling back to the local model. 0 disables the retry.
_comment_cloud_guard: Leak guard for hosted models (Gemini/OpenAI API): cloud_redact strips API keys, tokens, private keys, card numbers and your config secrets from every request; cloud_allow=false refuses all cloud calls (local models only).
_comment_gemini_cooldown: Seconds Gemini escalations fast-fail after a real outage (the retry also failed), so each HARD turn does not wait out a timeout before falling back to local. 429 rests at least 300s; 401/403/404 at least 3600s. 0 disables.
_comment_plugin_trust: Only load plugin files whose exact SHA-256 digest is listed here after review. Changes require re-approval.
_comment_filewatcher: ── File watcher — auto-index new/modified files into RAG ──
_comment_watch_dirs: Add paths to watch; leave empty to disable
_comment_dashboard: Web dashboard / phone remote runs on http://<this-pc-ip>:8000 if fastapi+uvicorn+cryptography are installed. No on/off flag yet — presence of the packages is the toggle.
_comment_headless: Env vars, not config keys — set AETHER_HEADLESS=1 to run on a server with no display/GUI/mic (interact via the dashboard/phone remote instead). AETHER_HEADLESS_AUTO_CONFIRM=1 auto-approves high-risk-action confirmations with no human review (off by default — they fail closed/denied headless otherwise). AETHER_NO_AUTOPUSH=1 stops the maintenance-doc auto-push to GitHub on every launch, useful for an unattended server.
_comment_ntfy: ── Push notifications for headless approval requests ────── No ntfy integration existed in this project before -- these are new keys, not a reuse of something pre-configured. With no ntfy_topic set, approval pushes are silently skipped (the request still shows up in the dashboard's Pending Approvals list either way -- ntfy is just how you find out about it without watching the dashboard).
